title: Saravanan Irukka Bayamaen
desc: Saravanan, a lackadaisical young man, stumbles into power as the local political head. Subsequently, armed with clueless confidence, he uses his new role to impress the girl of his dreams.

title: Pushpa 2
desc: A powerful smuggler confronts a revenge-seeking adversary, all while orchestrating political schemes, negotiating high-stakes transactions and manoeuvring through intense standoffs.

title: Good Night
desc: Mohan, an IT employee, has a perennial snoring problem. Later, when he gets married, his issue strains his marital relationship.

title: Maareesan
desc: Dhaya, a thief, sets out on a journey with Velayudham, who has Alzheimer's disease, intending to loot him. However, the trip ends up changing their lives forever.

title: Ragasiya Kolayaali
desc: Anwar is a consulting criminologist who helps the Kerala Police occasionally. When a string of serial killings happen in quick succession, he must race against time to find the one responsible.

title: Angamaly Diaries
desc: Vincent Pepe, a boisterous young man, gets involved in the world of crime after he loses his temper and acts irrationally during a dispute with a rival business group.

title: Damaal Dumeel
desc: A young, money-minded IT professional leads a happy life, until he gets fired from his job.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: To Let
desc: A family of three faces hardship as they desperately search for a new rental home after their landlady demands they leave their current house.

title: Cuckoo
desc: Tamil and Kodi, a visually impaired couple, undergo many hardships to unite when they learn that Kodi's brother has decided to marry her off to someone else in return for a favour.

title: Majili
desc: Poorna, an aspiring cricketer, falls into a deep depression after being abandoned by his lover, Anshu. Despite this, he is forced to marry his neighbour Sravani, who secretly has feelings for him.

title: Kaathu Vaakula Rendu Kaadhal
desc: Love knocks on the door of Rambo, an unlucky man. However, a dilemma arises when he develops feelings for two women at the same time.

title: Raid
desc: In what may be the longest raid of his career, a righteous income tax officer takes on a corrupt politician who will go to any lengths to evade legal consequences.

title: Hitler
desc: Selva's move to Chennai for work leads to unexpected involvement in crime. As the city falls into disarray, a dishonest politician manoeuvres for control.

title: Annabelle Sethupathi
desc: Rudra, a petty burglar, stumbles upon an uninhabited castle. However, when she learns of the tragedy marring its history, she vows to free the residents trapped against their will.
